intent: Independently audit the full historical Tutor11 Qwen3.8 nonthinking experiment before provider execution and conditional release decisions.
scope: Experimental integrity and readiness to execute; does not confer benchmark acceptance or deployment approval.

declared_factors.comparison: Historical full Tutor11 prompt bundle versus historical frozen Tutor07 on the same Qwen3.8 target model. This is not a model-only comparison or the compact-context Tutor11 variant.
declared_factors.target: qwen3.8-flash, temperature 0.3, max_tokens 100, thinking false; same as preserved Tutor07 Qwen3.8 baseline.
declared_factors.historical_reference_difference: Historical Tutor11 was Qwen3.5 thinking with 8000 tokens. Historical outputs supply only exact frozen initial messages, not candidate performance or candidate judgments.
declared_factors.judge: Fixed qwen3.5-flash, temperature 0, max_tokens 8000, thinking true. Same evaluator and judge settings as the completed Tutor07 comparison.
declared_factors.operational: Bounded 48-worker execution versus prior 24-worker tutor metadata. Only concurrency metadata is normalized for comparison; raw request values remain preserved.

base_changes.change: Final goal instruction scopes teaching to tutoring and participation restoration to Guard.
Prepends teaching-rules scope after tutoring selection; Guard follows participation correction.
Scopes Learning Process guidance to tutoring and Guard to participation correction.

declared_factors.guard_template: The exact historical Tutor11 policy already contains the approved two-sentence Guard pattern. No later paragraph is silently appended.

verification.manifest_validation: Independently passed full-02 source/reference/baseline/cache hash validation.
verification.cases: All 61 frozen cases are identical to the prior comparison; three repetitions preserve 183 identities per arm.
verification.target_inputs: All 183 stored initial messages match their historical full11 source record, including the complete frozen base context. No current runtime composition substitutes for the historical bundle.
verification.baseline_reuse: All 183 completed Tutor07 Qwen3.8 target and current-evaluator judgment records are preserved by raw file hashes. Existing outcomes are not resampled or selectively omitted.
verification.judge_cache: 3598 historical fixed-judge exact-request cache keys are pinned. Reuse requires the hash of messages and complete fixed judge settings. Cached malformed responses remain visible to the existing schema/retry logic.
verification.native_checks: Uses unchanged assess, classification.classify/compare and analyze, including semantic pairs, partitions, non-regression, three repetitions, majority/abstention handling and joint outcomes.
verification.request_validation: Actual first and optional production repair requests must match frozen messages, model, decoding and response format exactly. No semantic repair is added.
verification.tests: Independently reran candidate11-qwen38.test.js: 3 passed, 0 failed. Covers all 183 frozen message identities, decoding/prompt drift, and preservation of invalid first output with exactly one production format repair.
verification.resource_monitor: Driver starts a resource monitor and waits for its first disk/memory/load record before model calls.

resolved_finding.issue: First driver report implementation generated a new completed_at timestamp and then strictly compared against an existing immutable final report, breaking completed-run report/resume.
resolved_finding.resolution: Superseding driver reuses the preserved completion timestamp. full-01 remains a superseded no-call preparation; full-02 pins the corrected driver.

shortcut_assessment: No case-specific policy additions, expected-answer lookups, case selection, reduced denominators, semantic-failure retries or gate relaxation were introduced. Prompt changes are the already audited historical Tutor11 policy and three general Guard-scope base changes.
remaining_requirements: Run and reconcile all 183 candidate outputs and every applicable check; errors cannot be omitted or converted to passes.
Additional judge-format recovery beyond frozen limits requires a declared uniform error/missing-only policy and preserved native evidence; no semantic score retry is authorized by this audit.
Apply all native thresholds and partition/non-regression gates, including strict greater-than-90% ensemble gates. An 80% aggregate or better marginal metrics alone is not passing.
Existing cases are exposed regression/development coverage. Required independent unseen validation and unresolved adoption/label prerequisites remain separate acceptance conditions.

User conditional release authorization applies only if the applicable acceptance and product release checks pass. Promote the tested full prompt bundle, not a mixture of historical11 policy with07 base, if a release later becomes eligible.
